never: publish a figure with no definition, source or as-of time
show a previous value as current when the source cannot be read
write a number into the narrative that the figures do not carry
edit a published report in place
stays_with_person: what a figure means to a lender
whether a report goes outside the business

provider_block.job: the Monday report arrives on Monday, and every number can be traced

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the business's own sources and definitions register, on its own schedule.

checks.title: Every figure on the report names a definition in the register
One definition of every measure, computed once per period and reused
Every figure carries the source it was read from and the time it was read
The report publishes at the scheduled time whether or not anything changed
A figure whose source could not be read publishes as unavailable, with the reason
Prose on the report describes figures that exist and never states a number they do not carry
A figure past its declared threshold against the prior period notifies a named person that run
Each audience sees the figures declared for it and nothing else
A published figure changes only by a named person publishing a new version with the reason
For any period: the figures, definitions, sources, as-of times, versions and who published, retrievable
